hero.name: Joseph Elijah Miclat
hero.lede: A 20-year old environmentalist and 3rd-year college student from Angeles University Foundation with a passion for sustainable living and community engagement. I believe caring for the Earth should feel less like a distant ideal and more like something we do together, right where we live.
hero.portraitAlt: A person tending a community garden

paragraphs: SaveEarth started with a simple question: what if protecting the planet began with the places right outside our doors?

That question grew into a community of people who care about clean air, thriving habitats, and a future where nature and people can flourish side by side. We bring local hands and hopeful hearts to practical, lasting work.
story.personalNote: Due to the widely spread of pollution all over the world, I came up with the idea of creating a solution that can solve and benefit our mother earth. Here in SaveEarth, I do believe that we can make a change and it is never too late to take an action.

items.text: Start with the community already there.
Make room for everyone to take part.
Leave every place better than we found it.
